name: Ioun Stone (Reserve)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Cast a stored spell
powers.text: Cast a spell stored in the stone.

powers.name: Store a spell
powers.text: Outside a fight, a spellcaster casts a spell of level 1 to 3 into it (up to 3 levels).

summary: Stores up to 3 levels of spells cast into it, for you to cast.
text: An Ioun Stone is named after Ioun, a god of knowledge and prophecy revered on some worlds. While attuned to it, you can toss the stone into the air as a Magic action; it then orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 feet and confers its benefit on you. You can seize the orbiting stone as an action to take it back. This reserve stone: Stores up to 3 levels of spells cast into it, for you to cast.
